regulatory_model.quote: To practice optometry in this Commonwealth without holding a license issued by the Board.

credential_type.quote: Every candidate successfully passing the examination shall be licensed by the Board if such candidate possesses the qualifications required by law and regulation to practice optometry.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person: 1. To practice optometry in this Commonwealth without holding a license issued by the Board.

title_protection.quote: Any person who in any way advertises himself as an optometrist or uses the title of doctor of optometry (O.D.) or any other letters or title in connection with his name which in any way conveys the impression that he is engaged in the practice of optometry shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person: 1. To practice optometry in this Commonwealth without holding a license issued by the Board. Practicing or offering to practice optometry, or the public representation of being qualified to practice the same by any person not authorized to practice optometry, shall be sufficient evidence of a violation of the law.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in his practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any felony under the laws of the Commonwealth, another state, the District of Columbia, or any United States possession or territory or of any misdemeanor under such laws involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner that endangers health and welfare of patients or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in such a manner as to endanger the health and welfare of his patients or the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs rendering the optometrist unsafe to practice, or mental/physical illness rendering him unsafe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of alcohol or drugs to the extent such use renders him unsafe to practice optometry or mental or physical illness rendering him unsafe to practice optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully employing an unlicensed person to perform acts requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and willfully employing an unlicensed person to do anything for which a license to practice optometry is required;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Neglecting or refusing to display the current year license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Neglecting or refusing to display his license for the current year;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee by fraud or misrepresentation or practicing deception or fraud upon a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining of any fee by fraud or misrepresentation or the practice of deception or fraud upon any patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that deceives, misleads, or defrauds the public, claims professional superiority, or offers free services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that directly or indirectly deceives, misleads, or defrauds the public, claims professional superiority, or offers free optometrical services or examinations;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring, or inducing an unlicensed person to practice optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, or inducing a person not licensed to practice optometry to so practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not duly licensed to practice in the Commonwealth;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice optometry under a name other than one's own name as set forth on the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice optometry under a name other than one's own name as set forth on the license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lending, leasing, renting, or placing license at the disposal of an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lending, leasing, renting, or in any other manner placing his license at the disposal or in the service of any person not licensed to practice optometry in the Commonwealth;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Splitting or dividing a fee with persons other than a licensed optometrist who is a legal partner or co-member of a professional LLC
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Splitting or dividing a fee with any person or persons other than with a licensed optometrist who is a legal partner or comember of a professional limited liability company formed to engage in the practice of optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry where a non-licensed commercial establishment officer controls or influences the optometrist's professional judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing optometry where any officer, employee, or agent of a commercial or mercantile establishment, as defined in subsection C of § 54.1-3205, who is not licensed in the Commonwealth to practice optometry or medicine directly or indirectly controls, dictates, or influences the professional judgment, including but not limited to the level or type of care or services rendered, of the licensed optometrist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating other standards of conduct adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating other standards of conduct as adopted by the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating, assisting, inducing, or cooperating with others in violating any provisions of law relating to optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, assisting, inducing, or cooperating with others in violating any provisions of law relating to the practice of optometry, including the provisions of this chapter or of any regulation of the Board.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry includes: (1) Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics and the prescribing or adapting of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics for the correction, relief, remediation, or prevention of such conditions; (2) Employment of any subjective or objective mechanism to determine the accommodative or refractive states of the human eye or range or power of vision of the human eye; (3) Use of testing appliances for the purpose of the measurement of the powers of vision; (4) Examination, diagnosis, and optometric treatment in accordance with this chapter of conditions and visual or muscular anomalies of the human eye; (5) Evaluation, examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal or diseased conditions of the human eye and its adnexa by the use of medically recognized and appropriate devices, procedures, or technologies; (6) Preoperative and postoperative care related to the human eye and adnexa; and (7) Use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents set forth in § 54.1-3221.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry includes: 1. Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics

value: Examination and diagnosis of the human eye and its adnexa
Prescribing or adapting lenses, prisms, or ocular exercises
Visual training or orthoptics
Use of testing appliances
Evaluation and treatment of abnormal or diseased conditions of the human eye and adnexa
Preoperative and postoperative care
Use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents
Treatment with therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (TPA-certified optometrists)
Administration of intramuscular epinephrine for anaphylactic shock
Laser surgery (peripheral iridotomy, selective laser trabeculoplasty, YAG capsulotomy) for certified optometrists
methods_authorized.quote: An optometrist may (i) treat certain diseases or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa with certain therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as permitted under this chapter and (ii) administer intramuscular epinephrine for the treatment of emergency cases of anaphylactic shock.

drug_authority.value: TPA-certified optometrists may prescribe and administer Schedule II (hydrocodone/acetaminophen combination), III, IV, V, and VI controlled substances and devices; diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (Schedule VI topical) authorized for all licensed optometrists after June 30, 1997.
drug_authority.quote: TPA certification shall enable an optometrist to prescribe and administer, within his scope of practice, Schedule II controlled substances consisting of hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen and Schedules III through VI controlled substances and devices as set forth in the Drug Control Act

surgery_prohibited.quote: Except as provided in §§ 54.1-3222 and 54.1-3225, the practice of optometry does not include treatment through: 1. Surgery, including: a. Retina laser procedures; laser procedures into the vitreous chamber of the eye to treat vitreous, retinal, or macular disease; laser in situ keratomileusis and photorefractive keratectomy eye surgery; or other laser surgery;

surgery_definition.value: Treatment through revision, destruction, incision or other structural alteration of human tissue using laser technology, or incision/excision of ocular structures as enumerated in § 54.1-3201(B)(1).
surgery_definition.quote: "laser surgery" means treatment through revision, destruction, incision or other structural alteration of human tissue using laser technology.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: The foregoing shall not restrict the authority of any optometrist licensed or certified under this chapter for the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye and its adnexa

value: Peripheral iridotomy
Selective laser trabeculoplasty
YAG capsulotomy
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: The Board shall certify an optometrist to perform laser surgery consisting of peripheral iridotomy, selective laser trabeculoplasty, and YAG capsulotomy for the medically appropriate and recognized treatment of the human eye

value: Injection of steroid for treatment of chalazia
Probing or related procedures of the lacrimal system
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Administration of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents by injection shall be limited to the treatment of chalazia by means of injection of a steroid included in Schedule VI controlled substances

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Treatment of angle closure glaucoma shall be limited to initiation of immediate emergency care.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: administer intramuscular epinephrine for the treatment of emergency cases of anaphylactic shock.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics and the prescribing or adapting of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics for the correction, relief, remediation, or prevention of such conditions;

value: Schedule II limited to hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen only
Treatment of infantile or congenital glaucoma prohibited
Injections limited to steroid treatment of chalazia (Schedule VI)
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Treatment with oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents shall be limited to (i) analgesics included on Schedule II controlled substances as defined in § 54.1-3448 of the Drug Control Act consisting of hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen, and analgesics included on Schedules III through VI

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Treatment with oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents shall be limited to (i) analgesics included on Schedule II controlled substances as defined in § 54.1-3448 of the Drug Control Act consisting of hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen, and analgesics included on Schedules III through VI, as defined in §§ 54.1-3450 and 54.1-3455 of the Drug Control Act, which are appropriate to alleviate ocular pain and (ii) other Schedule VI controlled substances as defined in § 54.1-3455 of the Drug Control Act appropriate to treat diseases and abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa.

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: In order to be qualified for licensure as an optometrist, every applicant shall demonstrate competency for certification to prescribe for and treat diseases or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa with therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (TPAs).

value: Licensed optometrist
TPA-certified optometrist
Optometrist certified to perform laser surgery
tiered_license_types.quote: "TPA-certified optometrist" means an optometrist who is licensed under this chapter and who has successfully completed the requirements for TPA certification established by the Board pursuant to Article 5 (§ 54.1-3222 et seq.).

value: TPA certification (therapeutic pharmaceutical agents)
Laser surgery certification (peripheral iridotomy, selective laser trabeculoplasty, YAG capsulotomy)
specialty_certification_types.quote: The Board shall certify an optometrist to perform laser surgery consisting of peripheral iridotomy, selective laser trabeculoplasty, and YAG capsulotomy

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: A TPA-certified optometrist shall provide written evidence to the Board that he has completed a didactic and clinical training course provided by an accredited school or college of optometry that includes training in administration of TPAs by injection prior to administering TPAs by injection pursuant to this subdivision.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: delegating to personnel in his personal employ and supervised by him, such activities or functions as are nondiscretionary and do not require the exercise of professional judgment for their performance and which are usually or customarily delegated to such persons by optometrists, if such activities or functions are authorized by and performed for such optometrists and responsibility for such activities or functions is assumed by such optometrists.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: A regulatory board may require any applicant for registration, licensure, or certification to submit to fingerprinting and to provide personal descriptive information to be forwarded along with the applicant's fingerprints through the Central Criminal Records Exchange to the Federal Bureau of Investigation for the purpose of obtaining criminal history record information regarding such applicant.
